text_block_list.text:
It's just like they say, "Where there's a
will, there's
a way"! Don't you agree,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm back, baby! The Takarazuka Kinen
has just
witnessed a miracle!
Matikanefukukitaru for the
wiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Your fans are having a blast.

text_block_list.text:
Right? I was practically walking on air
when I
heard the cheers from the stands!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: We'll just have to keep up this momentum and push through the rest of summer. Speaking of which, it's been a while since we did that, hasn't it?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It's fortune slip time! Let's see where
we're racing
next!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm not falling back on old habits, don't
worry.
Back then, I was letting luck take
the wheel, but
today's different.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: So, please draw a slip, Trainer. Aaaand, go!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It looks like our next goal is the
Hakodate Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It looks like our next goal is the Kokura
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It looks like our next goal is the Sapporo
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Hakodate Kinen! Nice! That
million-dollar
nightscape is waiting for
us!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The Kokura Kinen! The dwelling place of
the gods
of fire! A summer down in
Kyushu is sure to bring
the heat!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The Sapporo Kinen! I guess the snow
festival
won't be happening in summer,
but I'm sure we
can think up something
just as festive if we win!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
So that decides our summer plans. But
know that I
didn't just leave it up to
luck, okay?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Then why did you choose this way?

text_block_list.text:
Well, this shows we can take on anything
that
fate has in store for us! So let's work
together to
have a blissful summer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
